en-US.description:
ValueVision helps you identify, value and decide what is worth selling from a photo.

VALUE AN ITEM
Photograph collectibles, antiques, technology, tools, fashion, homeware and everyday resale finds. ValueVision identifies the item, searches current market evidence and returns an estimated selling range, confidence level and marketplace guidance. Our AI evidence audit filters out mismatched models, accessories, bundles and unsuitable comparisons before a price is shown.

TREASURE HUNT
Photograph a room, shelf or collection. ValueVision builds a shortlist of promising finds, then lets you add close-ups for stronger identification and pricing. We ask for more detail when the evidence is not reliable enough instead of inventing a price.

CAR MODE
Photograph a vehicle or enter its registration. Get basic vehicle details, MOT, tax, latest recorded mileage and a market valuation. Optional full vehicle-history checks can reveal provider records for outstanding finance, stolen status, insurance write-offs, previous owners, mileage anomalies and other risk markers.

Every completed valuation is saved to My Collection.

The free download includes three starter Value Credits. ValueVision Plus costs £9.99 per month and includes 100 Value Credits every 30 days. One completed item valuation or Treasure Hunt item uses one credit. A basic car valuation uses three credits. Optional top-ups provide 25 credits for £3.99 or 75 credits for £8.99. Full vehicle-history checks are separate purchases at £4.50 each or three for £11.99.

Values and checks depend on the available market and provider data. They are guidance, not guaranteed sale prices, insurance valuations or formal appraisals.

review.notes:
No sign-in is required.

Review steps:
1. Open ValueVision and choose Value an Item, Full Car Check or Treasure Hunt.
2. Take or upload a clear photo. Manual vehicle-registration entry is also available.
3. Review the identification, estimated resale range, confidence guidance and market evidence.
4. If more evidence is needed, use Improve This Valuation and add the requested details.
5. Open My Collection to review saved results.
6. Open ValueVision Plus to view purchases, Restore Purchases and Manage Subscription.

The free download includes three starter Value Credits. Auto-renewable subscription Product ID ValueVision10 costs £9.99 per month and provides 100 Value Credits every 30 days. One completed item valuation or Treasure Hunt item uses one credit. A basic car valuation uses three credits. Consumable Product IDs valuevision_value_credits_25 and valuevision_value_credits_75 add 25 credits for £3.99 and 75 credits for £8.99.

Full vehicle-history checks are separate consumable purchases. Product ID valuevision_full_car_check_1 provides one check for £4.50. Product ID valuevision_full_car_check_3 provides three checks for £11.99. A provider request is made only after the user confirms the registration and has a valid StoreKit entitlement.
